status: model of the key-free upload Worker built from subnet/admission-worker (slop-ninja-admission-testnet), admission contract v2: no route takes an upload byte and the Worker has no R2 binding. Nothing in it is measured on this Worker yet: the JS reserve, glue costs and stack are the coordinator model's inputs (the same workers-rs 0.8.7, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions, the same hand-written export pattern), so the build uses the arena's unmeasured-model feature, which the arena accepts only together with observe (migration step 1: nothing the pool can physically serve is refused, every would-be refusal and overdraft is counted), and links growable linear memory under the ceiling below. Its routes: the public route holds one signed request, a body of at most one SubmissionUpload record, one roster RPC reply and its JSON tree, the forwarded message, the eval Worker's reply (its body relayed as raw JSON) or the cohort snapshot (the contract's 64 KiB response limit, its envelope and the repair list at its bound, one roster of hotkeys: 82,814 B), and at most one metadata read and parse (the parse admitted from the metadata's decoded length); the header route one header of at most 1 MiB (admitted as its own block), its decode and the outcome. The route footprints (route bounds version admission-upload-routes-2026-11-05-v3) are derived in src/routes.rs and run at their bounds under Strict by the native witnesses (src/arena_witness.rs, --features arena-witness). The roster of the subnet's hotkeys is a static array (2 MiB, static data below the pool), never pool pages.
page_bytes_source: WebAssembly page size, equal to the dlmalloc 0.2.12 system granularity
isolate_bytes_source: Cloudflare Workers limits: "128 MB per isolate", read as 10^6 bytes, the smaller of the two readings
js_reserve_bytes_source: the coordinator model's value (a linear memory ceiling of 1,536 pages), kept so the two models share one unmeasured JS reserve until this Worker's is measured through the inspector; this Worker's routes need far less linear memory than that ceiling
js_envelope_bytes_source: not measured: twice the largest body this Worker holds in JS before admitting it into linear memory, the 4 MiB metadata reply of the registration read (registry::MAX_LARGE_RESPONSE_BYTES), as the ArrayBuffer and its chunks; the header route's body (at most 1 MiB) and every other body are smaller
glue_static_bytes_source: the workers-rs 0.8.7 glue probe (subnet/crates/arena/glue-probe/memory-model.json, local workerd 2026-10-23, round2 run probe1): idle glue 872 B (hand-written exports), rounded up to the next power of two as the stated margin; this crate's lockfile pins the same worker, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions
glue_ticket_bytes_source: the glue probe's largest measured glue per entry with every export hand-written, one ticket per entry: 304 B (waitUntil continuation), rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker's hand-written fetch export (cf.rs) follow the probe's admitted pattern
glue_resident_bytes_source: the glue probe: 24 B per co-resident Durable Object instance, rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker defines no Durable Object class, so no resident is admitted
min_route_bytes_source: the smallest route control footprint: the 404 route's (routes::OTHER_CONTROL_BYTES, one page), checked by routes::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table
largest_route_bytes_source: the larger of the two routes: the public route's control footprint (routes::PUBLIC_CONTROL_BYTES = 2,428,408 B: the densest JSON tree of one 64 KiB roster RPC reply, 2 MiB, and four values of the public unit, the cohort snapshot at its bound, 82,814 B) with the two admissions a layout miss adds, the metadata reply as one block (registry::MAX_LARGE_RESPONSE_BYTES, 4 MiB) and its parse as a heap run at the reply bound (routes::metadata_parse_bytes(routes::MAX_METADATA_BYTES) = 11,346,732 B, the recorded rtao-core parse peaks in slop_ninja_arena::measured scaled to 2 MiB of metadata), or the header route's control footprint (routes::HEADER_CONTROL_BYTES, 2 MiB) with its body block (1 MiB), plus the scope's state page; checked by routes::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table
stack_bytes_source: rustc wasm32-unknown-unknown links the stack first with rust-lld's default -z stack-size=1048576 (scratch probe, 2026-10-31); the pool starts above static data, so the stack is outside every arena
stack_high_water_bytes_source: not measured on this build: the glue probe's 3,912 B (every workers-rs entry kind), a lower bound
